# IMD Business School

> IMD is a world-leading business school offering executive education, degree programs, and leadership development in management, digital transformation, AI, sustainability, and strategy.

Based in Lausanne, Switzerland, IMD delivers flexible degree programs (MBA, EMBA, Master's degrees) and executive education across multiple domains including AI and digital transformation, sustainability, leadership, strategy, and governance. The school serves global executives and professionals through blended learning formats and custom programs.

## Key Topics

- Executive Education
- MBA Programs

- AI Leadership

- Lausanne

## Degree Programs

- [1-Year MBA](https://www.imd.org/degree/mba): IMD's 1-year MBA program in Switzerland with global impact and leadership focus
- [Executive MBA](https://www.imd.org/emba/executive-mba): Flexible part-time Executive MBA for global leadership and career advancement
- [Master of Science in Sustainable Management and Technology](https://www.imd.org/msc/master-degree/sustainable-management-technology): Master's degree in sustainable management with University of Lausanne and EPFL
- [Executive Master in Sustainable Business Transformation](https://www.imd.org/sustainability/executive-master/sustainable-business-transformation): Flexible Executive Master degree in sustainable business transformation and ESG
- [Executive Master in AI & Digital Business Transformation](https://www.imd.org/digital-transformation/executive-master/ai-digital-business-transformation): Flexible Master degree in AI and digital business transformation leadership

## Executive Education Programs

- [Leading Digital and AI Transformation](https://www.imd.org/digital-transformation/ldait/leading-digital-ai-transformation): Europe's largest executive program in digital transformation and AI leadership
- [General Management Programs](https://www.imd.org/management-programs): World-leading general management programs for cross-functional leadership skills
- [Executive Leadership Programs](https://www.imd.org/leadership-programs): Human-centered executive leadership programs for strategic and team leadership
- [AI and Digital Transformation Programs](https://www.imd.org/digital-transformation-programs): AI and digital transformation programs for emerging technology leadership skills
- [Strategy Programs](https://www.imd.org/strategy-programs): Executive strategy programs for competitive advantage and future readiness
- [Sustainability Programs](https://www.imd.org/sustainability-programs): World-leading sustainability programs for responsible business transformation
- [Board & Governance Programs](https://www.imd.org/governance/board-programs): Board certification and governance programs with diploma pathways for directors
- [Geopolitics Programs](https://www.imd.org/geopolitics-programs): Executive programs for leading through geopolitical uncertainty and risk
- [Innovation Programs](https://www.imd.org/innovation-programs): Strategic innovation programs integrating innovation into leadership practice
- [Finance Programs](https://www.imd.org/finance-programs): Executive finance programs covering strategic finance and fintech leadership

## Online & Specialized Courses

- [Marketing Strategy in the Digital Age](https://www.imd.org/marketing/msda/marketing-strategy-digital-age): Online marketing strategy course for digital-age customer-centric approaches

## Program Discovery & Events

- [Program Finder](https://www.imd.org/program-finder): Search tool to find IMD programs by category, location and professional goals
- [Program Events](https://www.imd.org/events/programs-events): Masterclasses and information sessions for program discovery and enrollment
- [MBA Information Session](https://www.imd.org/event/mba/2026-03-31/information-session): MBA information session with career development guidance and recruitment advice
